human_repair_overrides.content: \nSelect the records with Sex = F instead of selecting Hemisphere = KD.
Use the numeric Sample IDs 2, 4, 6, and 8 as the test vector instead of their NeuN values.
Apply the Shapiro-Wilk test and report the resulting p-value as W.
